scientific_integrity: The six-parameter representation is 120-to-one; the equality space is a connected six-torus. Numeric tests supplement an exact argument. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive amplitudes and positive square frequencies only; finite fourth-moment phase maximization, not a sharp L2-to-L4 coefficient norm or a result for general polynomial spectra. Historical-priority uncertainty remains.
title: Six arithmetic phase symmetries of the square-spectrum fourth-moment majorant
